name: hyperloglog
description: A space-efficient probabilistic data structure for estimating the cardinality (number of distinct elements) of large datasets.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to count unique items in a stream or dataset under highly constrained memory limits, tolerating small estimation errors.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: Number of precision bits (typically 4 to 16). Higher values reduce error rates but consume more registers memory.
